name: 2nddesktop
description: A living scene on your desktop, for Windows and macOS
author: tuangatech

scripts.dev: npm run assets && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite" "wait-on tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 node scripts/run-electron.mjs ."
scripts.dist:universal: npm run build && node scripts/koffi-universal.mjs && electron-builder
scripts.attach:lab: npm run build && cross-env DESKTOP2_ATTACH_LAB=1 DESKTOP2_DEBUG=1 DESKTOP2_LAB_SECONDS=10 DESKTOP2_LAB_VARIANTS=base+show,layered+show,opaque+show,in-workerw+show node scripts/run-electron.mjs .
scripts.attach:lab:nogpu: npm run build && cross-env DESKTOP2_ATTACH_LAB=1 DESKTOP2_DEBUG=1 DESKTOP2_LAB_SECONDS=10 DESKTOP2_NO_GPU=1 DESKTOP2_LAB_VARIANTS=base,layered,opaque,base+show,layered+show,opaque+show node scripts/run-electron.mjs .
scripts.attach:lab:swcomp: npm run build && cross-env DESKTOP2_ATTACH_LAB=1 DESKTOP2_DEBUG=1 DESKTOP2_LAB_SECONDS=10 DESKTOP2_CHROMIUM_FLAGS=disable-gpu-compositing DESKTOP2_LAB_VARIANTS=base,layered,opaque,base+show,layered+show,opaque+show node scripts/run-electron.mjs .
